situations.title: GTCR explores potential takeover of Global Payments
situations.summary: GTCR, the largest shareholder, filed a Schedule 13D stating it may propose to buy Global Payments. No definitive decision has been made, and financing remains a key hurdle. The stock rose 10% on the news but still trades well below the reported $50 billion enterprise value.

situations.source: Lumentum’s CEO Says “the Laws of Physics Are Working in Favor of Fiber.” Marvell Holders Are Buying It Cheap
situations.title: Marvell-Lumentum merger pending regulatory approval
situations.summary: Marvell's all-stock acquisition of Lumentum, valued at ~$115B, is not yet closed. The deal needs regulatory approvals, including China's, and is expected to close in H1 2028. If blocked, Marvell owes Lumentum a $3.2B fee. Lumentum trades at a 16% discount to the deal value, reflecting uncertainty.

outcomes.label: Marvell stock moves significantly before close

situations.title: FDA agreement on Phase III FAP trial endpoint
situations.summary: Recursion Pharmaceuticals reached an FDA agreement on a key endpoint for its Phase III FAP trial. The trial outcome is pending, and success or failure will significantly impact the stock.

situations.title: TeraWulf CEO won't rush Muskie lease deal
situations.summary: TeraWulf's CEO stated he won't rush a lease deal for the Muskie site in a 'terrible market', while peers Applied Digital and Core Scientific have secured or are pursuing large hyperscaler leases. situations.title: CrowdStrike acquisition of Zscaler
situations.summary: CrowdStrike announced a $44B deal to acquire Zscaler. The deal is pending regulatory and shareholder approval, with integration risks.

situations.title: Bay du Nord project approved, FID pending
situations.summary: Canada and Newfoundland approved the $14B Bay du Nord offshore oil project development plan, but final investment decision (FID) is still pending. Equinor also recently contained a cyberattack. The stock has fallen sharply amid broader energy weakness.

situations.title: Semtech Q3 earnings report due after close
situations.summary: Semtech reports fiscal Q3 earnings after market close on Nov 23. The stock has fallen sharply from its 52-week high amid supply chain concerns and analyst target cuts. The report will test whether the AI data center growth story remains intact.

situations.title: EU Commission opens anti-trust probe into CCEP
situations.summary: The European Commission has opened an antitrust investigation into Coca-Cola Europacific Partners over cross-border beverage trade practices. The outcome of the probe could lead to fines or forced changes in business practices, impacting the company's European operations.

outcomes.label: Probe results in minor remedies or no action
Probe results in significant fines or operational changes
